lines.text: I'm fed up with this rain.

data.define: Used when you've had enough of a problem.

example.text: I'm fed up with this rain.

misuse.text: Don't tell your host you're 'fed up' with dinner.
misuse.why: It sounds like you hate the food.

publish.title: What does "fed up" mean?
publish.value: Fed up = Tired of something annoying. Example: "I'm fed up with this rain." (casual English).
